title: Stains don't  wash out
text:
Stains don't wash out. Every napkin that I used for Christmas breakfast that had a stain on it was still there after I washed it, I have had napkins before in the same fabric and they washed up like a dream.
I'm going to wash them again and if it doesn't come out, they are going back
